authorization.source: owner direct instruction in the current Codex session
authorization.scope: LTZZZ repository workflows that deploy on merge to main

already_automatic.mechanism: push to main triggers the matching .github/workflows/deploy-*.yml
already_automatic.note: Deployment was already automatic before this record; this record makes the authorization explicit and testable.

preconditions: tests required by the touched workflow pass
the change reaches main through the existing controller path
the previous deployment or version identifier is recorded before deploying

rollback.entry: record the prior worker deployment id or version id in the deploy receipt

phase_configs_not_flipped.config/patch-policy.json: A0 validation_only invariant; automatic_deploy must stay false
phase_configs_not_flipped.config/patchgate-a2.json: A2 docs-only invariant; automatic_deploy must stay false
phase_configs_not_flipped.config/patchgate-cloud-publisher.json: publisher invariant; automatic_deploy must stay false
phase_configs_not_flipped.config/pi-cloud.json: isolated pi smoke invariant; automatic_deploy must stay false

not_claimed: any specific deployment has already occurred under this record
